prerequisites: establish at least three independently evidenced source groups for train/validation/reserved test
freeze PyTorch CPU wheel/version/hash and setup cost
verify future model parameter tensors total6290
source_ID_use: trace/grouping/gather only, never numeric model features or embeddings
dynamic_preparation_scope: full current observed mesh normals and original-edge statistics, then gather two-ring context

normalization.continuous_feature_standardization: train observations only,5 node+4 edge means/std,18 persisted scalars

model.name: shared-cell local mesh residual expert
model.head: alpha_i*n_i + mean_j(beta_ij*(q_j-q_i))
model.fixed_boundary_halo_and_external_output: hard zero, add correction only to original binary64 writable observation copy
model.SO3_covariance: analytic design; observation preprocessing verified on4source examples under rotation+scale; actual network implementation not yet tested

supervision.target: full context (reference-observed)/observed_scale, all allowed normal points explicitly zero
supervision.damaged_case_loss: 0.2*mean_A +0.4*mean_S +0.4*mean_normal_free, empty terms omitted with remaining weights normalized
supervision.gradient_loss: 0.05*mean_directed_input_edges squared error of predicted-vs-target correction differences

training.sampling: source groups equal, patches uniform within training group, six radius/amplitude states in deterministic balanced cycle; overlaps retained in same group and reported

one_optimization: one evidence-based change after first round, same architecture/grouping/seed, if retraining at most1200more steps/1800s/2GiB

baselines.one_direct: residual-gated robust quadratic MLS, observation-only simultaneous projection
baselines.neighborhood_scope: same frozen two-ring context graph, observed edge-length geodesics
baselines.gate: train normal-control abs residual/scale percentile99.5, calibrated once
baselines.numeric_failure: zero correction and include failure in denominator

acceptance.aggregation: compute each damaged-case ratio/improvement first, then median/p95/worst; report group and member-file denominators
acceptance.MLS_nearzero_denominator: if MLS support RMSE<=1e-6*scale, case improvement=0 if model also<=threshold, else -model_RMSE/(1e-6*scale); report count and absolute errors
acceptance.normal_point_gate_aggregation: each case, for both normal_allowed and normal_free
acceptance.normal_denominators: report both all normal allowed and normal free; inspect per group/member/radius/amplitude and worst cases
acceptance.coupling: complete candidate impact-domain endpoint checks after full readback, zero new forbidden contacts and zero unresolved
acceptance.cost_comparison_scope: identical full prepare/readback/coupling chain, report MLS quality qualification separately
acceptance.reserved_test: open once after validation choice; no tuning from test labels
